summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Dimensional World ex U.S. Core Equity 2 ETF (DFAX) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund actively invests in non-US companies around the globe, with a focus on small- cap stocks. The fund's objective is long-term capital appreciation with consideration for tax implications of investment decisions. DFAX was launched on Mar 6, 2008 and is issued by Dimensional.

holdings.infoBox: DFAX is an equity ETF with a total of 10460 individual holdings. The top holdings are Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company stock at 3.52%, Samsung Electronics at 1.42%, SK hynix at 0.90%, ASML Holding at 0.65%, and Novartis AG ADR at 0.58%.
